summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor with in-memory Maps and some core entity types (brands, campaigns, tasks, user profiles) plus a new React app shell with authenticated routing, navigation, and initial UI components for sign-in, profile setup, brands, marketing campaigns, and tasks. Many requested MVP modules (dashboard KPIs/charts, CRO, products/SKUs, operations, reports/PDF export, knowledge base, decision assistant) are not evidenced in the provided diff summary, and stable persistence is not shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement RBAC with Admin/Editor/Viewer, backend-enforced permissions for all write operations, and an Admin UI to assign roles to principals (changes take effect without redeploy).
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows some authorization mixin usage in backend and a RequireRole component in frontend, but does not provide evidence of: (1) explicit Admin/Editor/Viewer role model end-to-end, (2) permission checks applied to all write operations (brand/campaign/task CRUD), or (3) an implemented Admin role assignment UI/page (only a route reference is shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Brand Management CRUD with key fields (products/pricing/margins/suppliers/ad budget and weekly/monthly goals), list + detail pages, RBAC, and persistent storage.
missing_requirements.reason: Brand create/edit dialogs exist, and a brand detail route exists, but there is no evidence of full CRUD including archive/delete, suppliers/products/pricing management UI, or persistence in stable storage (backend uses Map.empty without stable storage evidence).

missing_requirements.requirement: Performance Dashboard with per-brand and cross-brand KPI time-series charts and weekly/monthly period switching, with guidance empty states.
missing_requirements.reason: Dashboard route exists, but no dashboard KPI computation, stored time-series model, charts, brand selector, or weekly/monthly toggle is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Marketing Manager: log campaign performance tied to a brand; compare campaigns with sortable columns; underperformer highlighting based on configurable thresholds in Settings; creatives/copies as structured text plus optional URLs.
missing_requirements.reason: Campaign table supports sorting and highlights underperformers, but underperformance threshold is hardcoded (roas < 2.0) rather than configured in Settings; campaign create dialog does not show creatives/copies structured text; and there is no evidence campaigns are tied to a brand in the UI or backend API usage shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Website & CRO module: per-brand optimization checklist, A/B test tracker with statuses, and searchable UX feedback notes with timestamps.
missing_requirements.reason: CRO route exists but no checklist/A-B test/UX notes data model, CRUD UI, filtering, or search is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Product & Category Manager: SKU tracking per brand (including inventory), top/low performers view, and inventory alerts based on configurable thresholds.
missing_requirements.reason: Products route exists but no SKU/inventory entities, CRUD UI, performer calculations, or threshold-based alerts are evidenced in the diff summary; backend Product type shown lacks inventory field.

missing_requirements.requirement: Operations & Shipping: shipping partners, delivery times, RTO rate, cost per shipment, period logging with trends, and ops issues log with filtering.
missing_requirements.reason: Operations route exists but no operations/shipping data model, CRUD UI, trend views, or issues log is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Decision & Strategy Assistant: deterministic rule-based recommendations + weekly action plan generation and saving, based on configured thresholds and heuristics, with explanations and links to underlying data.
missing_requirements.reason: No recommendation/assistant logic, data structures, endpoints, or UI is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reports: weekly/monthly report views per brand and cross-brand, with charts and PDF export from frontend.
missing_requirements.reason: Reports route exists but no report generation UI, date range selection, chart rendering, or PDF export implementation is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Task & Workflow Manager: tasks with priority/due dates, filters, collaboration notes, and in-app reminders/indicators for due/overdue.
missing_requirements.reason: Task creation and completion toggle are evidenced, and overdue styling exists, but there is no evidence of task filtering UI, collaboration notes, or any in-app reminder indicator system beyond visual overdue border.

missing_requirements.requirement: Knowledge repository with categories, searchable entries (title/body), rich text formatting, attachments as links, persistence and RBAC scoping.
missing_requirements.reason: Knowledge route exists but no knowledge data model, CRUD UI, search, rich text, or RBAC-scoped persistence is evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Commit project documentation: architecture, UI flow, Motoko data model/storage layout, and phased MVP roadmap with deferred items called out.
missing_requirements.reason: No documentation files are evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Cohesive clean visual theme (not blue/purple), neutral analytics palette, consistent typography/layout for tables/metrics/charts, accessibility on mobile.
missing_requirements.reason: Some shared components and Tailwind classes exist, but there is no evidence of a defined non-blue/purple theme/palette, typography scale definition, or chart styling across main pages in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist data in canister stable storage (no external DB).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend storage is shown as in-memory Maps (Map.empty) and counters as vars; no stable variables or stable memory serialization/upgrade strategy is evidenced in the diff summary, so persistence across upgrades/restarts is not demonstrated.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret URL parameter-based access control initialization (caffeineAdminToken) and calling a backend _initializeAccessControlWithSecret method from the frontend actor hook.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request any secret-token bootstrap mechanism via URL parameters; authentication should be Internet Identity only, and RBAC role assignment should be done via Admin UI, not a hidden URL token flow.
